title: How India can KILL Corruption? Lessons from Singapore : Case study

👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, 2014 mein jab Narendra Modi Pradhan Mantri bane, tab unhone Bharat ki janta se ek bada wada kiya tha — “Na khaunga, na khane dunga.” 2014 ke election mein corruption sabse bada mudda tha. Isi baat ko lekar BJP ne Congress par itne aarop lagaye ki logon ko laga ki ab Modi sarkar Bharat ko bhrashtachar se mukt kar degi. Lekin aaj us waade ko 12 saal ho chuke hain, aur corruption-free Bharat ka sapna abhi tak poori tarah haqeeqat mein badal nahi paaya. Aaj bhi hum sab jaante hain ki Bharat mein police officer se lekar bade-bade neta tak, kai jagah rishwat lena ek aam baat ban chuki hai.

Lekin doston, zara sochiye — 70 saal se hum ek hi problem ko solve karne ki koshish kar rahe hain, phir bhi aaj tak is corruption ke virus ko khatam nahi kar paaye. Isi sawaal ka jawab dhoondhne ke liye maine pichhle 6 mahino mein 40 se zyada research papers padhe, 15 deshon ki GDP aur corruption index ka correlation nikala, aur har us desh ko study kiya jo gareebi se amiri tak pahucha. Aur finally mujhe iska jawab mila ek chhote se desh mein — Singapore. Singapore Mumbai jitna chhota desh hai jiske paas na zameen thi, na resources, na tel, na badi industries. 1960s mein Singapore ek gareeb aur asurakshit desh tha jahan 70% se zyada log jhopdi jaisi conditions mein rehte the, nadiyan naalon mein badal chuki thi, aur communal riots aam baat thi. Us waqt Singapore duniya ke sabse corrupt deshon mein se ek maana jata tha.

Lekin phir entry hui ek aise leader ki jisne is desh ki taqdeer hi badal di — Lee Kuan Yew. Unhone Singapore ko aise transform kiya ki aaj duniya uski taraqqi dekh kar hairaan ho jaati hai. Aaj Singapore mein Europe se bhi better infrastructure hai, trains Shinkansen se bhi zyada punctual maani jaati hain, aur wahan ka average aadmi mahine ka lagbhag 5 lakh rupaye kamata hai. Aur ye sab sirf isliye mumkin ho paaya kyunki Lee Kuan Yew ne Singapore mein corruption ko lagbhag khatam kar diya. Toh sawal ye hai — bina tel, resources aur industries ke Singapore itna ameer kaise bana? Lee Kuan Yew ne corruption ko kaise khatam kiya? Aur Singapore ki kahaani se Bharat kya seekh sakta hai? Yahi hum is episode mein samjhenge
